ordered_stages.gate: Exact Tamar anchors, manifests, canonical digests, clean state, and fresh equality.
Planning-only proposal, portfolio, source, method, workflow, sparse, and staged-review commit; push and fresh equality.
Only after x1 equality: implement owner-local toolkit profile, tests, skills, runners, artifacts, mutations, ledgers, and receipts.
Exact staged review, evidence and final commits, push, fresh equality, then one canonical invocation.
Fresh route reread, unique Sylven Arc resolution, immediate reread, one sanitized acknowledged send; never resend.

validation_policy: One dependency-justified exact-final canonical invocation after prerequisites. A failed aggregate earns zero success credit; isolate only the failed dependency. Never replay a successful component or successful aggregate.
full_repository_suite_owner: Eiren only absent newer exact live authority
boundary: Owner-scoped planning and software evidence only; every scientific, participant, professional, production, legal, cultural, Maori-authority, privacy-complete, accessibility-complete, exhaustive-security, independent-reproduction, AGI or ASI, consciousness or personhood, Theory-of-Everything, proof or canon, and Stage 20 boundary remains open or exact-gated.
